pattern_table.Subject: Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 Q), Quantitative Aptitude (30 Q), Constitution of India (10 Q), Current Affairs (10 Q), Comprehension in Gujarati & English (10 Q)

exam_pattern.details: The competitive exam comprises Part-A and Part-B conducted in a single question paper. A total of 3 hours (180 minutes) is provided. | Negative Marking: 1/4th (0.25) marks will be deducted for every wrong answer. Qualifying standard is minimum 40% for Part-A and 40% for Part-B.

syllabus.details: Part-A Syllabus: Reasoning & Data Interpretation, Quantitative Aptitude (Number systems, Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry), Constitution of India, Current Affairs of State, National & International importance, and Gujarati & English Comprehension. | Part-B Syllabus (Technical): Human Anatomy, Human Physiology, Applied Microbiology, General Pharmacology, Anaesthesia Technology, Healthcare and diseases (ECG, Respiratory failure, CPR), Instruments and Physics (ECG machines, Catheters, Pulse oximeter, Defibrillation, Ventilation, Gas physics), Communication, behaviour and computer applications.

how_to_apply: Visit the official OJAS portal at ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Click on "Online Application" and select "Apply" under GSSSB, then choose the relevant advertisement number 460/202627 for Operation Theatre Assistant.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not registered already, or login using your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
Fill out Personal Details, Educational Details, and upload bank account details for fee refund.
Upload scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specified dimensions (White background photo taken within 1 year).
Confirm your application and generate the Confirmation Number.
Pay the required application fee online through the OJAS portal before the last date.
Take a printout of the application form and keep fee receipt safe for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates must complete OTR (One Time Registration) on the OJAS website before applying. Ensure category and personal details are correct before confirmation, as no changes are permitted later. Only original certificates will be verified during document verification. Ex-servicemen and reserved category certificates must be issued by the competent authority in prescribed formats. Candidates must bring valid photo ID and printed admission ticket to the exam centre.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 16 vacancies are announced for the Operation Theatre Assistant post under advertisement number 460/202627.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 29 October 2026 up to 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Operation Theatre Techniques / Technician OR a minimum one-year Certificate Course in Operation Theatre Technology / Technician OR B.Sc. Medical Technology in Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 years and 35 years of age as on 29 October 2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for reserved categories, women, and PwBD candidates, which is refundable upon appearing for the exam.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a competitive examination (CBRT/OMR based) divided into Part-A and Part-B, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed pay of Rs. 26,000/- per month for the first 5 years, and subsequently move to Pay Matrix Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 - Rs. 63,200).

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the GSSSB Operation Theatre Assistant exam?
faq.answer: Yes, 1/4th (0.25) marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
